plants.original: The Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security issued a rule on Monday that requires licences for advanced chip shipments to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil. It says the five carry a higher-than-normal risk of diversion to China. Chinese firms barred from buying top GPUs had been able to rent them legally at data centres in those countries. The rule takes effect 90 days after it is posted to the Federal Register. Singapore said it is studying the measure, and Asian stocks fell.
